name: MDBList
description: Syncs watched status and ratings two-way between Jellyfin and MDBList, and pushes library/collection membership to MDBList. Uses MDBList's incremental sync API (last_activities + journal) for cheap, cursor-based updates instead of full-library reconciliation on every run.
overview: Two-way sync of watched status and ratings, plus collection sync, against MDBList

versions.changelog:
1.0.0.2: Fixes the plugin catalog icon's URL -- 1.0.0.1 published one with no host, which Jellyfin couldn't fetch at all.

1.0.0.1: Fixes scheduled syncs, "Sync now", and live scrobbling only ever acting on the first linked user when multiple Jellyfin users each have their own MDBList account connected. Adds a plugin catalog icon.

1.0.0.0: Initial release. Two-way sync of watched status and ratings, push-only collection sync, live playback scrobbling to MDBList's /scrobble endpoints, OAuth device-code authentication, incremental cursor-based pulls with automatic full-reconciliation fallback, a 24h scheduled full sync plus a 15-minute activity-gated cheap poll, and a config page for connecting your account and choosing what to sync.
